verdict.rationale: Termius's own documentation describes an AI feature that turns plain-language descriptions into shell commands. That is a first-party natural-language capability, but it only covers generating terminal commands. Nothing shows natural language can operate the product itself, such as connecting to hosts, managing vaults, or setting up port forwarding. Missing for 10: natural-language control of app features beyond shell-command generation, documentation of how generated commands are reviewed or executed, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Termius can convert a plain-language description into a shell command... Termius generates the command using AI.
Termius can generate commands from plain-language descriptions.
